opinion.headline: To win the deep-tech race, India needs ‘General Innovation Rules’
opinion.hook: India is launching ambitious science initiatives.
opinion.summary: However, current financial rules designed for conventional procurement hinder R&D. A new 'General Innovation Rules' regime is proposed. This will adopt a portfolio approach for high-risk research. It will redefine public benefit to include private actors. Milestone-based disbursements and multi-year commitments will be key. This aims to boost India's deep-tech R&D race.

opinion.headline: 12 years of PM Modi: India should not only be resilient but also be antifragile
opinion.hook: India faces significant global uncertainty and external challenges.
opinion.summary: Despite strong economic growth and improved financial stability, domestic investment remains a concern. The nation's resilience is being tested by fluctuating oil prices and global protectionism. Prime Minister Modi's leadership and the collective will of India are crucial as the country navigates these complex times.

opinion.headline: You'll always have mummy-papa bank
opinion.hook: After spending 46 years as a sadhu, an Indian man returned to his hometown, humbly requesting alms from his aging mother.
opinion.summary: This poignant moment encapsulates the deep-rooted Indian tradition where parents embody unwavering financial support. They are the ultimate safety net, granting aid without the constraints of contracts or interest rates.
